heading: Measures
proposed: Derived measures are built from base and derived terms. The expression validator sums base-measure exponents under the wrong key, so a derived measure can lose exponents (for example Volume = Area * Length can come out as Length^2 when the Length term is listed first). Until fixed, list derived-measure terms before base-measure terms in <app>'s measure definitions, or keep each derived measure to one base measure.
evidence: models/judo-meta-expression-esm:adapter-esm/src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/meta/expression/adapters/esm/EsmMeasureProvider.java:107 (checked in wt copy at 70668b8; latest develop not re-checked)
note: Measures are not in use per catalog, so impact is low. Gap is real: currentExponent reads the term's own measure key, not m.
